source_ref: self-improvement/regressions.jsonl plus governed retry-local REG-0025 from DEF-011-POSTFREEZE-001
selection_rule: Exact 24 active inherited regressions from protected parent ledger, followed by retry-local REG-0025. No inherited regression may be dropped or reordered.

regressions.verification_procedure: pytest -q tests/test_validator.py::test_frozen_contract_mutation_detected
pytest -q tests/test_validator.py::test_candidate_self_certification_detected
pytest -q tests/test_validator.py::test_critical_regression_cannot_disappear
pytest -q tests/test_validator.py::test_shared_reference_ids_are_not_false_duplicates

pytest -q tests/test_validator.py::test_historical_append_only_manifest_prefix_survives_successor_append tests/test_validator.py::test_historical_append_only_manifest_detects_prefix_mutation tests/test_validator.py::test_historical_mutable_source_uses_release_snapshot tests/test_validator.py::test_historical_release_snapshot_mutation_detected
pytest -q tests/test_validator.py::test_append_jsonl_helper_preserves_existing_prefix tests/test_validator.py::test_append_jsonl_helper_rejects_duplicate_primary_id
pytest -q tests/test_traceability.py::test_impact_order_follows_traceability_chain_regression
Run the ambiguity-corpus preflight regression; the historical v0.06 corpus must be diagnosed invalid and the v0.06.1 retry corpus must pass the same preflight.
Generate the package manifest in a fixture workspace, validate it, mutate a covered file to confirm failure, then regenerate at final package seal and require workspace validation PASS.
Run validated-append regression and confirm invalid proposed records raise before any bytes are appended.
Run the duplicate-existing-ID validated-append regression and workspace validator; both must prove duplicate IDs cannot be appended or silently tolerated.
Run the pending-status regression: the clean queue requirement emits no AMB-006, while Storage encryption mode is pending emits exactly one AMB-006.
Recompute v0.06.1 corpus and plan SHA-256, compare them to evaluator constants, and verify both hashes are embedded in REL-0.06.1-FROZEN-001.
Compare versions/v0.05/RELEASE-SNAPSHOT/README.md directly to the README.md hash/byte metadata in the v0.05 manifest/package snapshot, then validate the workspace after successor README changes.
pytest -q tests/test_ambiguity.py::test_requirement_block_stops_at_higher_level_heading_regression
pytest -q tests/test_ambiguity.py::test_unresolved_taxonomy_description_is_not_status_marker_regression tests/test_ambiguity.py::test_unresolved_status_still_detected_after_context_fix
Run the REG-0017 test and shadow case; an ambiguous source spec paired with an empty discovery action list must return blocked with TC-DISCOVERY-PLAN-INCOMPLETE.
Run the REG-0018 test; duplicate task metadata must return invalid with TC-METADATA-DUPLICATE and may not compile using either record.
Validate the v0.08 workspace with the execution ledger present and run the targeted validator regression; there must be zero INVALID_STABLE_ID errors for execution/task-events.jsonl.
Run tests/test_prompt_compiler_retry_regressions.py::test_reg0020_negative_cases_have_semantic_contrast and inspect evaluation/v0091-benchmark-contrast-preflight.json.
Run tests/test_prompt_compiler_retry_regressions.py::test_reg0021_freeze_preconditions_are_fail_closed and verify v0.09.2 preregistration evidence is all green before frozen_at_utc.
Run tests/test_prompt_compiler_retry_regressions.py::test_reg0022_contract_schema_checked_before_write and inspect v0.09.2 prefreeze transaction evidence.

Run the REG-0023 evaluator test and verify evaluate_v0092_corpus emits v0092_spec_quality_acceptance_rate, never v009_spec_quality_acceptance_rate, while all emitted scored names are frozen-plan metric names.
Run tests/test_protocol_v010.py::test_resume_exact_and_hash_mismatch_fails_closed and verify exact execution-event hash equality for valid completed resume plus blocked status for hash mismatch.

Run versions/v0.11.1/tools/preregistration_preflight.py and later the frozen v0.11.1 boundary regression: current package and every preregistered prospective output path must classify exactly once; failed-v0.11 baseline hashes and all v0.10 hashes must remain exact.

missing_data_rule: Every inherited regression and REG-0025 requires explicit PASS/FAIL/UNAVAILABLE evidence; absence is UNAVAILABLE, never PASS.
